author: ojiudezue
title: A scratch script named bisect.py shadowed the stdlib and fork-bombed pytest, hitting the Mac process limit
summary: Scratch helpers get distinctive prefixes and run with python -I; briefs now say so; a 30 s memory/swap/process watch guards the operator's terminal during long parallel runs.
why: Python puts a script's directory first on sys.path; any pytest started from the scratchpad imported the helper, which launched pytest again (~2,350 processes). It killed two agents before a Review C agent found it.
implications: Process spikes get a ps check for a recursive command line before blaming the suite.
